caseStudies.challenge: A family estate held by one family for more than forty years, coming to market for the first time in a generation. The task was to find the few buyers for whom it was the right house, and bring them to the same point at the same time.
caseStudies.campaign: Taken to auction. The home offered four bedrooms in double brick on a corner parcel, a saltwater pool, a helical staircase, two Jetmaster fireplaces and a studio.
caseStudies.result: Sold under the hammer on 14 February 2026 for $4,025,000.
